sentences.text:
This petition is filed to call for the records in respect of the FIR in Crime No.269 of 2022 now pending investigation on the file of the first respondent herein and to quash the same.
2. On the basis of the complaint given by the de-facto complainant Manikandan First Information Report in Crime No.269 of 2022 for the offence under Section 420 of IPC was registered by the Flower Bazaar Police Station.
The allegation against the petitioner/accused is that he had cheated the 2nd respondent/de-facto complainant by not paying the money payable due to supply of cashew nuts.
3. Now, it is claimed that both the accused/petitioner and the 2nd respondent/de-facto complainant have resolved their disputes and they don't want to proceed further with this case.
They filed joint compromise memo along with consent affidavit of the de-facto complainant/2nd respondent.

It is seen from the joint compromise memo and the consent affidavit of the de- facto complainant that petitioner had paid the money due to the 2nd respondent https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis and the 2nd respondent does not want to proceed further.
He has no objection for quashing the First Information Report in Crime No.269 of 2022 on the file of the first respondent herein.
4. Parties were present before this Court and they were identified by Mr.S.K.Janakiraman, Special Sub Inspector of Police, C-1 Flower Bazaar Police Station.

This Court also enquired both the parties and they reiterated that they resolved the dispute and the 2nd respondent doesn't want to proceed further.
5.
Under such circumstances, no useful purpose will be served in keeping the First Information Report pending, even though, the offence involved is not compoundable in nature.

In the light of the guidelines given by the Hon'ble Supreme Court reported in 2017 9 SCC 641-(Parbathbhai Aahir @
Parbathbhai Vs. State of Gujrath), this Court in exercise of its jurisdiction under Section 482 Cr.P.C.,
quashes the First Information Report in Crime No.269 of 2022 on the file of the first respondent herein.
